name: Live Wire Electric
old_description: Your Trusted Choice for Top-Grade Residential Electrical Wiring Work
about:
Live Wire Electric has served the Black Hills region from Rapid City, South Dakota, for more than 27 years. The company is solely owned and operated, providing electrical wiring services to both residential and commercial customers.

Its service portfolio covers residential wiring for new homes and remodeling projects, as well as commercial wiring ranging from TV cabling to big-box store installations. Additional offerings include LED retrofitting for commercial and residential properties, exterior lighting, trenching, and 24-hour emergency response. The company also provides free on-site estimates for prospective jobs.

Customers include homeowners, general contractors, and retail businesses such as big-box stores. The firm’s commercial work extends to television and data cabling, while its residential side handles everything from basic wiring to lighting upgrades.

Live Wire Electric emphasizes its longevity and direct ownership as differentiators, noting that calls are returned the same day and that emergency crews are available around the clock.

name: Living Designs Furniture
old_description: See our furniture up close in our showrooms in Houston. Explore custom options, feel the fabrics, and get guidance from our in-store experts—no appointment needed.
about:
Living Designs Furniture operates from Houston, Texas, where it has been handcrafting custom furniture for more than 45 years. The company was founded by Youval Meicler, who arrived from Israel at age 21 and worked his way up from sweeping floors at a furniture manufacturer to learning every aspect of the craft. Determined to offer better quality without inflated markups, Meicler established the business as a family-owned operation that remains under family stewardship today.

The company manufactures sofas, sectionals, chairs, bed frames, ottomans, outdoor pieces, and dining banquettes in its Houston factory. Skilled craftsmen build each item using solid wood frames and precision-stitched finishes, with customers choosing from over 25 collections and customizing dimensions, configurations, fabrics, and leathers. In-stock inventory is available for next-day delivery, while custom orders typically ship in 8–10 weeks.

Living Designs serves residential homeowners, interior designers through its Designers + Partners Program, and hospitality clients such as lounges and dining areas. The showroom model allows walk-in consultation, and the firm also supplies Texas Mattress Makers, a sister brand from the same family.

Meicler's founding principle—that people deserve better quality, better prices, and a better experience—still drives the business. The company emphasizes locally sourced materials, transparent pricing, and a hands-on design process that lets customers tour the workshop and see their furniture take shape.

name: Lombardo Sheet Metal Works
old_description: We are a leading provider of HVAC duct fabrication and installation, along with various other sheet metal related tasks throughout all of RI, MA and CT.
about:
Lombardo Sheet Metal Works operates from Providence, Rhode Island, serving customers across Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and Connecticut. The business runs under the name Frank Lombardo & Sons, Inc., indicating a family-owned lineage, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed; the company notes it has provided HVAC duct systems for over 40 years.

The shop specializes in full-service HVAC contracting and custom sheet metal fabrication. Its core work includes duct fabrication, modification, insulating, zoning, and controls, as well as HVAC design, installation, and repair. Beyond standard ductwork, the team produces custom exhaust solutions, chimney caps, kitchen hood installations, stainless and copper drain pans, furnace tie-ins, whole-home humidifiers, flue pipe and boiler flue work, and air filtration systems. All fabrication and installation is performed in-house, with the company holding licenses in all three states.

Lombardo serves commercial, residential, and industrial clients throughout the tri-state area. Commercial projects range from office building ventilation to restaurant kitchen exhaust systems. Residential work includes whole-home humidifier installations, chimney cap replacements, and duct zoning for improved comfort. Industrial customers rely on the shop for custom duct modifications and specialized exhaust solutions.

The company emphasizes a personal, customer-focused approach, aiming to satisfy each client through direct communication and tailored solutions. Its long tenure in the region reflects a commitment to reliable, licensed service across state lines.

name: Los Angeles Fashion Consulting & Production
old_description: Our team specializes in sustainable practices, offering strategies for eco-friendly sourcing and production to minimize environmental impact.
about:
Los Angeles Fashion Consulting & Production operates from a studio in Los Angeles, California. The company was founded to provide integrated design, manufacturing, and sourcing services for fashion brands, though its exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm offers a full spectrum of apparel development services under one roof: fashion design consulting, tech pack creation, pattern making, sample development, and end-to-end manufacturing solutions. It also manages sourcing and supply chain logistics, connecting clients with material suppliers and production partners. The team works from a local Los Angeles studio, allowing brands to collaborate in person from initial concept through finished garment.

Clients range from early-stage fashion startups launching their first collection to established labels scaling production. The company has worked with brands such as FEFU (From Earth For Us), which praised the team’s ability to execute patterns to specification. Its guides address topics like cut-and-sew versus private label, finding a clothing manufacturer in Los Angeles, and pricing for wholesale and retail.

The company emphasizes sustainable practices, offering strategies for eco-friendly sourcing and production to minimize environmental impact. Its stated differentiators include housing design, manufacturing, and sourcing disciplines in a single location, providing a local Los Angeles studio for face-to-face collaboration, and delivering end-to-end manufacturing services that take a brand from sketch to finished product.

name: Loudon Sheet Metal
old_description: Merrick-Kemper has REMAINED ONe OF THE MOST RESPECTED FABRICATORS AND INSTALLERS IN THE INDUSTRIAL SHEET METAL INDUSTRY SINCE 1902.
about:
Merrick-Kemper, headquartered in Jeffersontown, Kentucky, has been a fixture in the sheet metal and roofing trades since its founding in 1902. The company describes itself as guided by a family legacy, though founder names are not disclosed in its public materials. It began as a sheet metal fabricator and installer and has expanded into a full-service provider for architectural, industrial, and roofing applications.

The firm operates a main office and fabrication facility where it performs custom duct fabrication, precision sheet metal work, heavy industrial fabrication, and restoration of existing industrial sheet metal systems. Its service portfolio spans inspection, design, fabrication, installation, maintenance, and repair for architectural sheet metal (including copper steeple coverings and custom cornices), HVAC systems, metal wall panel systems, and slate, tile, and metal roofing. The company also fabricates and installs baghouses for industrial clients. No facility square footage, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Merrick-Kemper serves the construction industry across commercial, industrial, and residential sectors. Its customer base includes contractors, business owners, and homeowners, with testimonials citing work for commercial facilities and residential roofing projects. The company highlights expertise in architectural sheet metal for historic and new buildings, HVAC ductwork for commercial facilities, and industrial sheet metal for heavy-duty applications such as baghouse systems.

The company states that its differentiation lies in a commitment to craftsmanship, integrity, accountability, and a family-legacy culture that emphasizes continuous improvement and team-first values.

name: Louisiana Fish Fry Products
old_description: Make tonight Cajun Night with playlists curated by New Orleans native Trombone Shorty
about:
Louisiana Fish Fry Products traces its roots to 1959, when Tony Pizzolato opened a small produce stand in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. By 1972 the stand had grown into a thriving seafood business, and in 1982 the company was formally established as Louisiana Fish Fry Products to bring authentic Cajun flavors to a wider audience. The business remains US-owned and US-made, with its plant and headquarters still in Baton Rouge.

The company manufactures a range of dry mixes and seasonings, including batters and coatings for frying, seafood boil blends, baking mixes, sauces and marinades, entrée and rice mixes, spices and seasonings, and gift boxes. Production takes place at its Baton Rouge facility, where recipes developed over more than six decades are blended and packaged for both retail shelves and foodservice distributors.

Louisiana Fish Fry Products serves two primary channels: retail consumers through grocery stores and foodservice operators such as restaurants, institutions, and caterers. The foodservice line offers larger package sizes for high-volume cooking, while the retail line provides consumer-friendly portions for home cooks preparing dishes like crawfish boils, fried chicken, and gumbo.

That focus on authenticity, combined with domestic manufacturing, is presented as the reason customers choose the brand.

name: Lowell Electronics
old_description: Lowell Electronics specializes in giving you the high-tech electronic sales, service, and installations for
about:
Lowell Electronics has operated from Lowell, Arkansas since 1972. The business was founded by Dan and his wife Carmen, who remain the owners and work directly with customers. What began as a local electronics sales and service shop grew into a full-line home theater superstore serving the Northwest Arkansas region.

The company sells and installs high-definition televisions, projectors, surround-sound systems, outdoor TVs and audio, security cameras, structured wiring, home automation, satellite systems, and whole-house audio. It carries brands such as LG, Samsung, Klipsch, Epson, JVC, Vutec, Yamaha, Denon, Marantz, and Peerless Mounts. Installations are performed by qualified technicians and include commercial 70-volt audio systems as well as custom residential home theaters. The showroom and office are located in Lowell.

Customers range from homeowners in Bella Vista, Bentonville, Rogers, Springdale, and Fayetteville to businesses needing robust distributed-audio systems. The firm has handled projects such as Starlink satellite internet mounting on difficult roofs and complete home theater builds, drawing on more than 50 years of combined experience in the area.

The founders emphasize providing only the services a client requests, avoiding unnecessary add-ons, and treating every customer as they would want to be treated. This approach, coupled with direct owner involvement on every job, is cited as the reason customers return for upgrades and refer neighbors.
